description: Africa Topo-Moisture Potential is a data set listed in Africa GeoPortal (Esri), a continental ArcGIS Hub, published or maintained by Regional Centre for Mapping of Resource for Development. Created as part of the USGS’s Africa Ecosystems Mapping project, the Africa Topographic Moisture Potential layer classifies the landscape of Africa as either uplands or as lowlands and other depressions.This layer provides access to a 100m cell size raster derived from SRTM and other data that divides the African landscape into upland and lowland areas. Coverage: Africa (the listing does not name one country). The portal files it under the publisher Regional Centre for Mapping of Resource for Development. Its tags are Africa, Hillshade, Relief, Topography, Drainage. The portal shows 2023-08-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record platform-africa-geoportal-esri.
